email_template.subject: Security Alert: Transaction Declined at m_07 (Ref: b81a6b31)
email_template.body:
Dear Customer,

A payment of INR 1,033.00 attempted at m_07 was declined by our automated fraud detection system to protect your account against unauthorized transactions.

If you did not initiate this transaction, please reach out to your card-issuing bank immediately to secure your instrument. If this was authorized by you, please complete one-time identity verification here: https://merchantguard.razorpay.com/verify/b81a6b31.

Regards,
Merchant Risk & Fraud Security Team
